description: Targeted mutation for PR #11's ConflictChecker candidate bounding-box filter. This mutation applies only after PR #11's production patch adds the candidate overlap predicate; the predicate is absent from the f11331c base.

mutants.test_filter: Conflict checker matches pairwise results for overlap and separation
mutants.description: After PR #11 adds bbox-based candidates, force its cross-object overlap predicate to reject every line. The deterministic overlapping pair must still be found by the pairwise reference, while the optimized checker must report the same distinct object-ID pair; the positive result assertion should fail under this mutant.
